codedPivotImplementation.feature: Choose coded source categories in Rows before adding visible columns
codedPivotImplementation.domUsability: Rows → Categories to columns offered direct Observation component values by type. The full integer lifecycle took 26 clicks; the two-column string lifecycle took 27 clicks, including setup, saved editing, preview, reload, removal, and table cleanup.
codedPivotImplementation.resultCorrectness: One selected CDA Observation produced Days to collection = 162 and, in a separate string family, Specimen type = analyte and Primary disease type = Ductal and lobular neoplasms. Independent Arango reads matched all three code/value pairings.
codedPivotImplementation.persistence: Applied integer and string coded Pivots, reloaded and previewed source-correct values, reopened each saved operation, changed missing-value handling to ERROR, applied, reloaded, confirmed the saved policy and unchanged values, removed the operation, and reloaded with no construction steps. Both disposable tables were deleted.
codedPivotImplementation.remaining: Full-table performance and other source families need separate measurement. Bounded integer and string saved-edit lifecycles passed.

pivotCategoryDiscovery.feature: Find category values in the Rows pivot editor
pivotCategoryDiscovery.domUsability: The bounded BodyStructure path found and selected 135 categories in 1.834 seconds; Specimen ID overflow and sparse body-site refusal messages appeared in the editor
pivotCategoryDiscovery.resultCorrectness: Arango confirms 135 distinct BodyStructure IDs. The high-cardinality Specimen ID request returned LIMIT_EXCEEDED with a 257-row overflow witness and skipped the full category query.
pivotCategoryDiscovery.persistence: The bounded table pivot applied, survived reload, and was removed through the saved-step UI
pivotCategoryDiscovery.performance: BodyStructure discovery took 1.834 seconds in Chrome. A warm Specimen overflow request took 2.54 seconds, including a 675 ms witness. One cold request took 8.55 seconds; the earlier timeout cause remains unconfirmed.
pivotCategoryDiscovery.remaining: Measure cold and concurrent category requests

indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.feature: Add a two-hop Patient column to CDA Specimen rows
indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.domUsability: Add columns → Fields and related data exposed Patient beyond the direct Specimen fields. The route chooser offered Specimen → Observation → Patient and showed match coverage before selection. Full lifecycle used 35 clicks including bounded table setup, editing, restoration, and cleanup.
indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.resultCorrectness: The selected Specimen b7cad184-db67-5542-a975-10fffa3e89e7 returned Patient afcfb15e-7617-5691-ae2c-ab675322fb33 through specimen_Specimen then subject_Patient. Independent Arango edge traversal confirmed the route and value. Coverage showed one displayed row with one match.
indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.persistence: Applied, reloaded and previewed, reopened the exact saved route, changed the output label, applied, reloaded and previewed unchanged values, removed the step, and reloaded the restored Specimen table. Disposable table deleted.
indirectRelatedColumnEvidence.remaining: This case has one match. Zero and many related matches require their separate CDA cases; reducing route-selection clicks remains a usability opportunity.
